purpose: CA-108 point-in-time downstream denominator mechanics for market-cap-like and institutional-flow normalization. Research-only; not official market-cap reconstruction and not alpha inference.

codeAudit.currentWorkerPattern: marketCapYi may fall back to sharesOutstanding * close / 1e8 when explicit marketCapYi is absent
codeAudit.replayRisk: A historical price multiplied by a current or semantically mismatched share snapshot can create a look-ahead/denominator-vintage error.

namingRule: Values below are denominator-derived NOTIONAL_CAPITALIZATION, not exchange-certified official market capitalization unless the exact source methodology is independently proven.

flowFixture.reason: Fixed mechanics-only numerator isolates denominator effects. It is not a real institutional-flow observation and has no directional interpretation.

interpretation: Using the later 93,946,031 share state on 2025-11-18 would be a future-vintage leak.
Using public-tradable supply answers a different economic question from registered issued capital.
The same raw institutional net-share numerator can differ materially after normalization solely because the denominator semantic changes.

institutionalFlowRules: Preserve foreignNet/trustNet/dealerNet/institutionTotalNet raw share counts exactly as sourced.
Do not rescale raw net shares for pure SUPPLY_CHANGE.
A normalized flow feature must include denominatorType, denominatorValue, effectiveSession, knownAt and source provenance.
Buy-day streaks are sign/count semantics; do not silently convert them into turnover-normalized features.
Holding percentage and net trading flow are different objects. A holding percentage can change mechanically when the denominator changes with zero holder trading.
marketCapRules: Historical fallback market cap may be computed only when the selected share denominator is semantically appropriate and point-in-time admissible.
Current share snapshots may not be backfilled into earlier prices.
Registered issued, listed/tradable and free-float capitalization are distinct objects.
If exact historical share vintage is missing, leave historical derived capitalization UNKNOWN rather than substitute a current value.
valuationRules: EPS_WEIGHTED_AVERAGE_SHARES is not a daily trading denominator.
Retrospectively restated EPS denominators must not be reused to reconstruct historical daily turnover or market capitalization.
Historical P/E/P/B should prefer archived official valuation snapshots/methodology; do not synthesize an old valuation with a current share base to fill a gap.
antiInference: Fixed 100,000-share flow is synthetic mechanics only.
No market-cap ranking or eligibility change.
conclusion: Downstream denominator effects are mechanically material and can create future-vintage or semantic mismatches. Raw flows remain factual; normalized flows and derived capitalization require explicit point-in-time denominator contracts.
